title: ArchitecturalDataset
description: Formal Draft-07 schema for styles.json metadata contract in the Architecture Profiling tournament engine.

$schema.description: Optional URI or relative path to the validating schema.

categories.description: Exhaustive list of balanced architectural categories.

styles.description: Complete collection of 10 balanced architectural styles with 5D aesthetic traits.

id.description: Unique machine-readable snake_case identifier for the category.

description_en.description: Detailed English architectural narrative describing this category.

description_it.description: Detailed Italian architectural narrative describing this category.

color_hex.description: RGB hex color code with leading hash for category badge styling and radar charts.

traits.description: 5-dimensional continuous aesthetic vector defining architectural coordinates in [0.0, 10.0]^5.

era.description: Historical timeline axis: 0.0 = Antiquity (c. 500 BC), 10.0 = Cutting-Edge Contemporary.

ornamentation.description: Decorative density axis: 0.0 = Stripped Minimalist / Pure Form, 10.0 = Lavish / Hyper-Decorated.

structural_honesty.description: Tectonic legibility axis: 0.0 = Clad / Concealed Structure, 10.0 = Raw Béton Brut / Exposed Exoskeleton.

geometric_order.description: Spatial symmetry axis: 0.0 = Strict Axial / Bilateral Symmetry, 10.0 = Fluid / Parametric / Non-Orthogonal.

material_warmth.description: Haptic material axis: 0.0 = Cold Glazing / Polished Steel, 10.0 = Warm Natural Masonry / Terracotta / Stone.

style.description: Individual architectural style entry within the tournament dataset.

id.description: Unique 1-based sequential integer identifier matching tournament array indices.

filename.description: Local asset image filename in shared/images/ (e.g. arch_01_classical.png).

style_en.description: Official architectural style name in English.

style_it.description: Official architectural style name in Italian.

base_weight.description: Initial prior weight multiplier for Bradley-Terry preference modeling (default 1.0).

color_hex.description: Individual style brand accent hex color with leading hash.
